get.summary: Lists the subfolders of a server folder, for picking a root.

post.summary: Checks a folder can be added and proposes a layout template from what's in it.

get.summary: Liveness check that also confirms the database answers.

Everything the home screen shows: continue watching, coming up, shows, and
what needs attention.

put.summary:
Sets whether a series or episode is monitored. Emits `item.wanted` and
`item.unwanted` for episodes whose wanted state changes.

get.summary: Every library with its roots, file counts and scan state.

delete.summary: Deletes an empty library. Its folders must be removed first.

get.summary: Where the next file for a series in this library would go, under each write policy.

post.summary: Adds a folder to a library and starts its first scan.

delete.summary: Removes a folder from its library. Refused while its files are linked to items.

patch.summary: Changes a root's write policy, layout template or import target flag.

get.summary: A series with its orderings, playlists, metadata and locations.

A series' episodes in one ordering or playlist, with availability, files,
watch state, gaps and up next.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: `ordering:<id>` or `playlist:<id>`. Defaults to the user's view, then the default ordering.

put.summary: Sets the ordering or playlist that drives the user's "next up" for a series.

post.summary: Validates a layout template and splits it for display, for live editing.

in_progress.description: Wanted items an external tool is working on.

EpisodeNumber.description: An episode's number in one ordering or playlist. Formatting is up to the client.

ErrorBody.description: Error body for every non-2xx response.

stale.description: Past its expiry: the tool stopped reporting.

folders.description: Subfolder names, hidden ones left out.

oneOf.description: The most recently watched series' next episode.

online.description: Whether the root folder is reachable right now.

path.description: Relative to the root; None when nothing is written to this root.

filename.description: The name the file arrives with.

location.description: The series' stored folder on that root.

examples.description: Item folders it finds, e.g. "Night Harbor (2019)".

grouped.description: Files the template groups into an item folder.

reason.description: Why this template, in a sentence.

offline_since.description: When a scan last found it unreachable; cleared by a successful scan.

online.description: Whether the folder is reachable right now.

oneOf.description: Set while a scan runs; filled in by whoever runs scans.

done.description: Files probed so far, during probing.

queued_again.description: Another scan is due when this one finishes.

started.description: False when a scan was already running; one more runs after it.

monitored.description: The series' own setting; episodes inherit it unless set themselves.

selected_view.description: The current user's view, or the default ordering.

new_episodes.description: Available, unplayed episodes whose file arrived in the last 7 days.

monitored.description: `null` inherits from the parent (an episode from its series).

error.description: What's wrong, when it isn't valid.

TemplateRole.description:
How a piece of a template is shown: grouping levels, the item folder, levels
below it, or a `/` separator.

source.description: Where it comes from: a provider (`tmdb`), `user`, or `smart`/`manual` for playlists.
